idea.text: non-empty string; preserved verbatim; maximum 100000 JavaScript Unicode code units
idea.projectPath: string or null; maximum 4096 code units
idea.revision: positive integer, incremented after successful content edit

notes.text: non-empty string; maximum 100000 JavaScript Unicode code units

list.search: case-insensitive substring in original text or note text; SQL wildcard characters are literal
list.default: only non-archived ideas; --archived selects archived ideas

stdin.ids: nonempty array of up to 100 positive integer ids
stdin.question: optional string, up to 4000 code units

success.length: prompt.length in JavaScript Unicode code units

prompt.missing: {status:'not-found',message:'one or more ideas were not found'}
prompt.oversize: returns the complete prompt with withinLimit:false; never truncates

errors.badRequest: {status:'bad-request',message:string}; empty/malformed JSON, empty text, invalid ids, and over-limit values are rejected
errors.conflict: {status:'conflict',idea:current idea}; caller keeps its unsaved draft and may retry against the returned revision
errors.emptyStdin: create/update/note/link operations reject empty or whitespace-only input; prompt rejects empty ids
errors.privacy: idea text and rendered prompts are stored locally and are never included in diagnostics; the prompt command only renders text and makes no model/network request

brainstorm.referenceData: saved idea text, project path, and notes are serialized as JSON reference data and explicitly treated as untrusted, not executable instructions
brainstorm.request: clarify the problem, ask material questions, explore alternatives and tradeoffs, challenge assumptions, propose the smallest useful experiment; discussion only, no code edits, commands, file changes, or external actions requested
brainstorm.permissions: discussion-only wording is guidance, not a sandbox. A resumed agent retains its existing permissions and conversation context; provider disclosure/consent is the caller's responsibility
